name: Buffer API
description: Buffer's GraphQL API for managing social media publishing. Provides queries for account, organizations, channels, posts, post metrics, daily posting limits, and ideas, plus mutations to create, edit, and delete posts and create ideas. All operations are sent as GraphQL queries or mutations to a single endpoint.
